title: 关于炼狱熔炉
text: Infernal Kiln is a powerful contraption that drops from quest Hephasto on Hell.
To power it, harvest Crystallised Cindersouls from slain Abyssal enemies.
**To execute all below recipes, you have to use Infernal Kiln.**

title: 超级材料转换配方
text: - 15x Crystallised Cindersoul + Any uber material from:
- Can only convert for the materials for the same boss
- Has 90% chance to convert to any other material from the same boss
- Has 10% chance for conversion to not result in any change

title: 完美宝石增殖配方
text: Any perfect gem in non-stacked form + 10x Crystallised Cindersoul = 50x of that gem

title: 工艺注入制作配方
text: - 15x Crystallised Cindersoul + 5x Jewel Fragment + 5x Perfect Gem (check below) = 5x Crafting Infusion:

title: 获得随机地狱锻造暗金
text: - 35x Crystallised Cindersoul + 5xMythic Orb = Random Hellforged Unique
- Please mind that the roll outcomes are weighted

title: 获得指定地狱锻造暗金
text: 50x Crystallised Cindersoul + Divine Orb + Unique you want to convert = Unique converted to Hellforged part, if it exists

title: 命运卡牌增殖
text: Sacrifice a Fate Card to either obtain another one or lose it
Recipe: Infernal Kiln + 50x Crystallised Cindersoul + 1x Any Fate Card

title: 重铸憎恨宝珠类型
text: Reroll Hatred Orb to different type
- Hatred Orb of Equipment - 25% occurence rate
- Hatred Orb of Accessories - 21% occurence rate
- Hatred Orb of Essences - 17% occurence rate
- Hatred Orb of Fate Cards - 15% occurence rate
- Hatred Orb of Runes - 12% occurence rate
- Hatred Orb of Currency - 10% occurence rate
Recipe: Infernal Kiln + 25x Crystallised Cindersoul + 1x Any Hatred Orb

title: 获得腐化精华
text: - Infernal Kiln + 1x Any Perfect Essence + 1x Crystallised Cindersoul = Essence of Insanity
- Infernal Kiln + 1x Any Perfect Essence + 1x Crystallised Cindersoul + 1x Key = Essence of Hysteria
